title: 第23章 这洗脑能力堪称一绝第24章 连滚带爬狼狈躲闪
slug: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
lines: 第23章这洗脑能力，堪称一绝
周秀兰望着训练场上空那片渐渐暗下来的天幕，眼神变得悠远而虔诚，“月神赐予我们光月之核，不是让我们来这人间争强好胜的。我们存在的意义，是为了守护，为了封印世间污秽，为了不让黑暗吞噬光亮。”
她转过头，目光灼灼地看着安怜，那眼神仿佛能穿透皮囊，直视灵魂：“抽签抽到谁，是运气。但敢不敢站上去，是骨气。我们是月亮选中的孩子，哪怕面对的是太阳，也不能还没打就先跪下。你这一退，退掉的不是一场比赛，是你对月神的敬畏，是你身为光月觉醒者的骄傲。”
安怜的心脏像是被什么东西撞了一下。
周秀兰的话，像一颗石子投入她的心湖，激起层层涟漪。
她从来没想过这些。
她只知道光月觉醒者稀有，厉害，能拿奖学金，能卖个好价钱。
她忙着攒钱跑路，忙着应付三个男朋友，忙着计算得失。
却唯独忘了，月亮照耀着她的路，而她拥有的这份力量，不是为了争强好胜，不是为了计算得失。
是为了守护。
安怜低头看向自己的手。
它能画出魔法阵，也能敲键盘翻译稿件，更能……抚平伤痛。
她忽然明白了周秀兰为什么八十二岁了还要来。
不是执念，是尊重。
是对这份天赋的尊重，是对赋予她这份天赋的存在的尊重。
一股热血冲上头顶。
她凭什么退缩？就因为对手强？那这身本事是用来干什么的？摆着看的吗？
更何况，她都没打，她怎么就确定自己会输呢？
ss级又不是sss级！
嗯……好像，对于她这个s级的来说，两者并没有什么太大的区别。
热血上头快降下来也快，但周秀兰有一句话没说错。
抽签抽到谁，是运气。但敢不敢站上去，是骨气。
她不能没骨气！
安怜坚定了上台比试的想法，她甚至觉得，周秀兰这老太太不去搞传销或者做销售，真是屈才了。
这洗脑能力，堪称一绝。
沈千尘坐在选手区最角落的位置，双腿随意地交叠着，一手搭在膝盖上，另一只手拿着通讯终端。
屏幕上是一份选手名单，每个人的名字后面都跟着详细的资料。
他的目光停在第二十四行。
安怜，光月元素，S级天赋评级，十九岁，圣罗兰贵族学院在读。
封印术成绩：年级倒数第一。
实战经验：无。
沈千尘微微挑眉，把终端翻过来扣在膝盖上，仰头靠在椅背上，闭上了眼睛。
安怜。
这个名字他听说过。
不是因为她有多厉害，恰恰相反，是因为她太弱了。
S级光月觉醒者，封印术年级倒数第一，这在整个圣罗兰的历史上都是独一份。
其他S级的光月觉醒者，哪怕天赋再差，封印术至少也能混个中等水平。
毕竟封印是光月元素的核心能力之一，就像治愈一样，是与生俱来的本能。
但安怜却是一个例外。
她的封印术差差到老师们都在私下讨论，说她是不是天赋评级搞错了。
content_en:
Chapter 23 This brainwashing ability is truly unparalleled
Zhou Xiulan looked at the gradually darkening sky above the training ground, her eyes becoming distant and pious, "The moon god gave us the core of light and moon, not for us to come to this world to compete. The meaning of our existence is to protect, to seal the filth in the world, and to prevent darkness from swallowing up the light."
She turned her head and looked at An Lian with a burning gaze, which seemed to be able to penetrate the skin and look directly into the soul: "Who you draw by lot is luck. But whether you dare to stand up or not is integrity. We are the children chosen by the moon. Even if we are facing the sun, we cannot kneel down before the fight. By withdrawing, you are not withdrawing from a competition, but your reverence for the moon god, and your pride as a person who has awakened the light moon."
An Lian's heart seemed to have been hit by something.
Zhou Xiulan's words were like a stone thrown into her heart, causing ripples.
She never thought about this.
She only knew that the Awakened Ones of Light and Moon were rare, powerful, could get scholarships, and could be sold for a good price.
She was busy saving money to run away, busy dealing with three boyfriends, and busy calculating gains and losses.
But she just forgot that the moon was shining on her path, and the power she had was not for the purpose of being competitive or calculating gains and losses.
It's for protection.
An Lian looked down at her hands.
It can draw magic circles, translate manuscripts by typing on the keyboard, and even more... heal pain.
She suddenly understood why Zhou Xiulan still came at the age of eighty-two.
It's not obsession, it's respect.
It is respect for this gift and respect for the being who gave her this gift.
A rush of hot blood rushed to the top of his head.
Why should she back down? Just because the opponent is strong? So what is this skill used for? Just showing it off?
What's more, she didn't even fight, so how could she be sure that she would lose?
SS level is not SSS level!
Hmm... It seems that for an S-class like her, there isn't much difference between the two.
The blood boiled down quickly, but Zhou Xiulan was right about one thing.
Whoever you draw is luck. But whether you dare to stand up or not depends on your integrity.
She can't be spineless!
An Lian was determined to compete on stage. She even felt that the old lady Zhou Xiulan was really humiliating her talents by not engaging in MLM or sales.
This brainwashing ability is truly outstanding.
Shen Qianchen was sitting in the corner of the player area, with his legs folded casually, one hand on his knee, and the other hand holding a communication terminal.
On the screen is a list of players, with detailed information following each person's name.
His eyes stopped on line 24.
An Lian, element of light and moon, S-level talent rating, nineteen years old, studying at Saint Laurent Noble Academy.
Sealing Technique Score: Last in grade.
Practical experience: None.
Shen Qianchen raised his eyebrows slightly, turned the terminal over and clasped it on his knees, leaned back on the chair and closed his eyes.
An Lian.
He had heard of this name.
It's not because she's so powerful, on the contrary, it's because she's too weak.
An S-class Light and Moon Awakener, the last in the sealing arts grade, this is the only one in the entire history of Saint Laurent.
Other S-level Awakeners of Light and Moon, no matter how poor their talents are, can at least reach an average level in sealing skills.
After all, sealing is one of the core abilities of the Light and Moon Elements. Just like healing, it is an innate instinct.
But An Lian is an exception.
Her sealing skills were so bad that the teachers were discussing privately whether her talent rating was wrong.
